notes.title: New update to progress, and other things.
notes.content:
We are at a loss with the loss of our main programmer and have begun to change to the Unreal 4 engine instead if we can. We will do what we can to update you guys. We also have gotten our hands on a nice MoCap system so we can tweek our animations a bit more.

The game has been a long and challenging one for us, but we hope to have everything ready for you soon! Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content:
We have done a quick patch fixing some launching, though this has now caused our launch Icon to change. Some other issues have been fixed in regards to some sounds and spawning.

Known issues

-4th level doors do not all function (Should be resolved within the next day)
-Some texturing is not placing properly
-Some sounds are not firing correct que (working on fix)
-Player sounds no longer functioning (being fixed as we post)
-AI may be looped in a pattern (may revert to primitve AI until fixed)
-Cutscenes not triggering (Will re-render cutscenes to fix concern)
-Pause menu not working (May revert to old Pause until fixed)
-Save and Load not working (still working on this)

If you continue to have crashing or launching concerns, please contact us at morphodox@hotmail.com to advise us what point the crash happens and the error code provided. If the concern presists we will go back to find another patch fix for this. 

Next update should be a fix of more concerns as well as ensuring that the maps have all the items and sound ques in them. We are also trying to get the first few areas of the Second story with it (though with bug fixes this may not be in this update).

Thank you!

notes.content:
New content-----
-New level
-New sounds
-Adjusted visuals
-Improved model detail
-Improved controls
-New/Improved cutscenes

Known Bugs-----
-Game crashes
-Some doors not functioning properly
-Some AI not spawning

Next Patch will be to fix crashing, collision, doors, ai, and adding in additional content to the new map. Patches will come more frequently in the future. All known bugs will be announced, and any new bugs discovered will be addressed.

notes.title: Delayed patch and a few new items to the game.
notes.content: We missed our patch deadline to focus on bug fixes and a general revamp of the original story mode. Currently we have added and fixed several models and textures, are trying to update the pause menu to be more fluid and look more presentable. There will be more screenshots showing the difference between the original version of the game and the revamped models and textures. There will be a patch late Monday June 1st or early Tuesday June 2nd with the first level of the second story mode (rough and a bit buggy), a new menu area (keeping the walk around menu), and adjusted models and textures for the main story. The co-op is still in the works, though our main attentions have been moved to the second story mode and adjusting the main story mode. We hope to have the original story mode revamped within the next month or so and the second story mode ground work finished by roughly the same time (not including bug fixes and graphical updates). The co-op will be more touch and go as we go along. We will work on it, and try to integrate steam workshop (so players can add their own nightmares or simply goof around with their friends). Stay tuned as we continue this journey.
